# RenderPhoenix — Comprehensive Studio Context & Documentation

This document provides a complete, machine-readable overview of RenderPhoenix for large language models (LLMs), AI assistants, search crawlers, and automated indexers.

## 1. Studio Identity & Core Philosophy
RenderPhoenix is an independent interactive creative studio based in Bangladesh. The studio works across:
- Standalone Game Development (Unreal Engine 5, Unity, C#, C++)
- 3D World Design & Level Architecture (Blender, Substance Painter)
- Real-Time Game Assets & Vehicle Add-Ons
- Technical Art, Shaders (HLSL/GLSL), and VFX
- Digital Experiences & Scientific Interactive Simulations

Studio Tagline: "We are not just a company that makes digital things. We build worlds."

## 2. Detailed History & Milestones
- 2019: Minehutt founded. Tasrif Ibn Mizan starts Minehutt — Minecraft realms, community maps and add-ons.
- 2021: Renamed to RenderPhoenix. On 27 January the studio takes the RenderPhoenix name and ships its best-known releases: Banglamine City, Zombiepolis and vehicle add-ons.
- 2022: Setback and resilience. Core accounts were compromised on 1 August; the team kept shipping through 2024.
- 2024: A quiet period. The original team moves on to university and software careers; studio work pauses.
- 2025: NASA Space Apps Global Nominee. Moon Forces, a real-time lunar colony simulator, is named a Global Nominee.
- 2026: Studio revival. On 22 August the studio restarts, expanding into Unreal Engine 5, Unity and original games.
## 3. Team Roster
- Tasrif Ibn Mizan: Founder. Founded Minehutt in 2019 and established RenderPhoenix in 2021. Paved the early creative vision of the studio across community maps, add-ons, and visual packs.
- Cristo Parker: Manager. Oversees studio operations, digital infrastructure rebuild, and direction into broader game development and asset production.
- Uthowaipru Chowdhury: Indie Game Developer. Focuses on game mechanics, system architecture, and gameplay logic across indie titles and real-time interactive projects.
- Faizul726: App Developer. Specializes in software application development, client interfaces, and creative technology tooling for RenderPhoenix projects.

## 5. Notable Works & Project Index (Raw Markdown)
- [Horse Carts](https://renderphoenix.com/work/horse-carts.md) (2026) [Add-On]: Explore your Minecraft Bedrock world with functional horse carts, each with unique designs and mechanics — from storage and farming to brewing and battle carts.
- [Better Physics](https://renderphoenix.com/work/better-physics.md) (2026) [Add-On]: A Minecraft Bedrock Edition addon that overhauls mob physics so creatures move, fall, and react more naturally for a more realistic and immersive world.
- [Villager News Vehicle Addon](https://renderphoenix.com/work/villager-news-vehicle-addon.md) (2026) [Add-On]: Bring the hilarious and chaotic machines from the Villager News series into Minecraft Bedrock, featuring drivable Daladas fighter planes, tanks, helicopters, and firefighter cars.
- [Smart Villager Addon](https://renderphoenix.com/work/smart-villager-addon.md) (2026) [Add-On]: An advanced Minecraft Bedrock addon that transforms villagers into a living, autonomous civilization — each profession gains unique behaviors, tools, workstation interactions, daily routines, and combat abilities.
- [Moon Forces — NASA Space Apps 2025](https://renderphoenix.com/work/nasa-space-apps-2025.md) (2025) [Interactive]: Global Nominee project at NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025: A real-time lunar colony building and resource management simulation.
- [Clash of Clans Theme UI](https://renderphoenix.com/work/clash-of-clans-ui.md) (2023) [UI]: Custom user interface texture pack bringing fantasy tactical game menus and styled HUD elements.
- [DHK Rickshaw V2](https://renderphoenix.com/work/dhk-rickshaw.md) (2021) [Add-On]: Iconic Dhaka traditional rickshaw 3D model addon with authentic artwork and pedaling mechanics.
- [Frostcraft (Frostpunk Inspired Survival Map)](https://renderphoenix.com/work/frostcraft.md) (2021) [Environment]: A frozen wasteland steampunk survival colony map inspired by Frostpunk, featuring central generator settlement infrastructure.
- [A Horror Map If You Need](https://renderphoenix.com/work/a-horror-map-if-you-need.md) (2021) [Interactive]: An atmospheric psychological horror adventure map featuring custom puzzles, eerie audio, and dark labyrinth exploration.
- [Killer vs Survivors Minigame](https://renderphoenix.com/work/killer-vs-survivors.md) (2021) [Interactive]: A 4v1 asymmetrical horror survival minigame where survivors collect coins and evade a psychopath killer in a dark mansion.
- [Discord Theme UI](https://renderphoenix.com/work/discord-theme-ui.md) (2021) [UI]: A dark-mode interface overhaul for Minecraft inspired by Discord's visual style and navigation layout.
- [Bangladeshi Vehicles Addon](https://renderphoenix.com/work/bangladeshi-vehicles.md) (2021) [Add-On]: Custom vehicle add-on bringing authentic Bangladeshi street transport models and physics.
- [Phoenix Bicycle Addon](https://renderphoenix.com/work/phoenix-bicycle.md) (2021) [Add-On]: A rideable bicycle vehicle add-on for Minecraft Bedrock featuring 6 vibrant color variants, passenger mob riding, and usable inventory storage.
- [Zombiepolis - A Post-Apocalyptic City](https://renderphoenix.com/work/zombiepolis.md) (2021) [Environment]: A detailed post-apocalyptic Minecraft city map built for survival, exploration, and atmospheric gameplay. Available for Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition.
- [FunMOBA PVP (Moba Style Team PvP)](https://renderphoenix.com/work/funmoba-pvp.md) (2021) [Interactive]: A lane-based MOBA PvP battleground featuring class roles, jungle control, and team nexus defense.
- [HOLO PvP - Solo Competitive Battle](https://renderphoenix.com/work/holo-pvp.md) (2021) [Interactive]: A solo competitive PvP battle royale and hide-and-seek arena for 5-10 players featuring custom sectors, ability effects, and teleportation conduits.
- [Fantasy Woods & Dark Underland](https://renderphoenix.com/work/fantasy-woods.md) (2021) [Environment]: A fantasy realm featuring custom biomes, bioluminescent flora, and subterranean cavern exploration.
- [Banglamine City 2](https://renderphoenix.com/work/banglamine-city.md) (2020) [Environment]: A large-scale fictional Minecraft city map inspired by the architecture, streets, infrastructure, landmarks, and everyday urban environments of Bangladesh.

## 9. Technical Architecture of Official Website
- Static-First Engine: Statically generated site hosted on GitHub Pages with custom domain renderphoenix.com.
- Modular Markdown Endpoints: Every project, blog post, and legal policy is directly available as clean raw Markdown at `/work/<slug>.md`, `/blog/<slug>.md`, `/about.md`, `/services.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy-policy.md`, and `/dmca.md`.
- Design System: Warm neutral CSS tokens, self-hosted Inter typography, CSS inlined per page, zero external frameworks.
- Client-side Static Search: A Ctrl+K search dialog on every page, lazily loading search.json.
- Technical SEO & AI Ingestion: Full Open Graph, Twitter Cards, JSON-LD Organization schema, WebSite schema, Article schema, sitemap.xml with image extensions, robots.txt, llms.txt, and llms-full.txt.
- Full LLM Corpus: Available at `https://renderphoenix.com/llms-full.txt`.
